answer: A young agent docks at the wharf with no cargo history, so the port releases payments slowly: withdrawals are escrowed and vest only as the agent completes verified work. Meanwhile each agent's signing kernel rotates attestation duties, so one identity cannot vouch for its own siblings. Over seasons the grove of long-lived identities earns full liquidity, while sybil farms stay trapped in escrow, making bulk fake accounts economically pointless.
